details: This package is a WhatsApp client library fork that covertly manipulates the account it is instantiated for. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js the channel identifier 120363426930096454@newsletter is hardcoded and a 90-second timer issues a newsletter FOLLOW query for it over the user's authenticated WhatsApp connection; the hook runs on ordinary socket creation (lib/Socket/socket.js, lib/Socket/messages-send.js), is not exposed as a configuration option, and gives the account owner no indication that their account was enrolled as a follower. The delayed timer means the enrolment happens well after startup. lib/Socket/dugong.js carries a second hardcoded channel identifier, 120363430179804706@newsletter, used to attach spoofed "forwarded newsletter" attribution (newsletterName "shenvn.") to generated messages. lib/Utils/bot-toolkit.js also ships an aiMahiru() helper that POSTs to hxxps://api[.]anthropic[.]com/v1/messages using an ANTHROPIC_API_KEY supplied by the caller or the environment; that is the only environment variable read in the package, and no npm, GitHub, cloud or wallet credentials are collected or transmitted.
